statistics.interpretation_guardrail: Levels and smoothed-series correlations are descriptive and inflated by shared trends/autocorrelation; first differences emphasize short-term variability and do not estimate equilibrium climate response. Causal attribution must use the assessed physical evidence in attribution files.
